description: Convert an HTML snippet to React JSX: class to className, for to htmlFor (and 60+ other attribute renames, SVG attributes like stroke-width to strokeWidth), inline style strings to style objects, self-closing void elements, comments to {/* */}, escaped braces in text, input value/checked to defaultValue/defaultChecked, and inline event handlers wrapped in arrow functions. Multiple top-level nodes are wrapped in a fragment. Optionally wraps the result in an exported function component. Returns the JSX plus warnings about anything that needs a manual look.

componentName.description: Optional PascalCase component name, e.g. "Hero"; wraps the JSX in `export default function Hero() { return (...) }`

html.description: The HTML snippet or document to convert

name: html_to_jsx
